name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-read-image
description: A plug-and-play image-reading plugin for DeepSeek Harness. After installation, DSH will no longer refuse to feed images into sessions with pure-text models; instead, the image will be mapped as [Image #N] in the session. The Agent can then invoke tools on its own to read images from the session or from specified paths.
